cardPages.title: World of Warcraft Classic Game Data APIs
cardPages.cardDescription: Endpoints for World of Warcraft Classic classes, races, items, and other game information.

html:
World of Warcraft Classic provides APIs to access game data, including information about creatures, classes, races, items, and so on.

Before you can use the APIs, you must set up your client and secret as described in Getting Started.
